source: Message library · WhatsApp booking assistant · Lerato's Braids & Beauty (demo)
note: Text between *asterisks* is WhatsApp bold. [Square brackets] are placeholders to keep. Templates use {{n}} variables; sample values are given.

messages.name: First message from someone new
messages.trigger: Someone who has never messaged the salon sends anything. Asks for consent before we send reminders (POPIA).
messages.body:
Hi! I'm the automated booking assistant for *Lerato's Braids & Beauty*. I can book, change or cancel appointments.

May we send your confirmations and reminders here on WhatsApp? Reply STOP at any time to stop. Privacy notice: [privacy link]
clientSaidBefore: Hi, I'd like to book braids
messages.note: “No reminders” still lets them book: we only send replies inside the 24-hour window and no templates. Their answer is stored on the client profile with the date.

messages.name: Shortlist when the first message names a service
messages.trigger: Their first message mentions a service (“braids”). We offer the closest matches as buttons.
messages.body: Great. Which service would you like?
messages.note: If nothing was named, we send B03 instead.

messages.name: Choose a service
messages.trigger: No service named yet, or they tapped “Other services”.
messages.body: Which service would you like?
messages.footer: Prices are paid at the salon

rows.title: Ask a person
rows.description: For anything not on this list

messages.name: Choose a day
messages.trigger: A service is chosen. Lists only days with open times, soonest first, and skips days we’re closed.
messages.body:
*Knotless braids* take about 4 hours and cost R 650.

Which day suits you?
messages.footer: Reply PERSON to talk to us
messages.note: Open question 1: a list of the next open days beats “Tomorrow / Saturday / Pick another day”. It never offers a full or closed day, and the row says how many times are open.

messages.name: Choose a time
messages.trigger: A day is chosen. Shows start and end, and who it’s with when there’s a choice.
messages.body: These times are open on *Saturday 7 November*. Tap one to choose.
messages.footer: Reply PERSON to talk to us

rows.title: Another day
rows.description: Back to the list of days

messages.name: Ask for a name (new clients only)
messages.trigger: New client, and their WhatsApp profile name may not be their real name. The one place we ask them to type.
messages.body: Thanks! What name should we put the booking under?
messages.note: Skipped for returning clients. The reply is saved as the client’s name, not their WhatsApp profile name.

messages.name: Confirm the booking
messages.trigger: Service, day and time chosen. The slot is held for 5 minutes while they decide.
messages.body:
Please confirm your booking:

*Knotless braids* with Lerato
Saturday 7 Nov, 08:00 to 12:00
R 650, paid at the salon
messages.footer: Reply PERSON to talk to us

messages.name: Booked
messages.trigger: They tapped Confirm. The booking appears in the calendar straight away.
messages.body:
You're booked, Lindiwe!

*Knotless braids* with Lerato
Saturday 7 Nov, 08:00 to 12:00
[Salon address], Randburg

We'll remind you the day before. To change or cancel, just message us here.
messages.note: Always repeats service, staff, day, start and end, and place. Never “see you soon” without the details.

messages.name: Returning client
messages.trigger: A known number messages again. Greets by name and offers the last booking again.
messages.body: Welcome back, Lindiwe! Would you like to book *Knotless braids* with Lerato again?

messages.name: Slot taken while choosing
messages.trigger: Someone else booked the time between list and confirm (or the 5-minute hold ran out).
messages.body: Sorry, *08:00 on Saturday 7 Nov* was booked by someone else a moment ago. These times are still open:
messages.footer: Reply PERSON to talk to us

rows.title: Another day
rows.description: Back to the list of days

messages.name: Nothing free this week
messages.trigger: No openings in the next 7 days for this service.
messages.body: Knotless braids are fully booked this week. The next open times are:

messages.name: A day we’re closed
messages.trigger: They type a day the salon is closed (Sunday, Monday, a public holiday or the owner’s time off).
messages.body: We're closed on Mondays. The closest open day is *Tuesday 10 November*.

messages.name: A date in the past
messages.trigger: They type a date that has already passed.
messages.body: 3 November has already passed. Did you mean a date coming up?

messages.name: Typed request understood (AI)
messages.trigger: The AI is confident about service and day. It repeats what it understood and waits for a tap. It never books from a guess.
messages.body:
Just to check, I understood:

*Knotless braids*
Saturday 7 Nov, in the morning

The first open morning time is 08:00.
clientSaidBefore: can i get braids sat morning
messages.note: Open question 6: show only what it understood, as the same short summary we use to confirm, with no explanation of how. “Not right” falls back to the service list.

messages.name: Typed request not understood (AI)
messages.trigger: The AI is unsure, or the message isn’t about bookings.
messages.body: Sorry, I didn't quite understand that. What would you like to do?
clientSaidBefore: can u do the thing from last time but shorter

messages.name: Voice note, photo or sticker
messages.trigger: Anything that isn’t text or a tap. The owner still sees the media in the inbox.
messages.body: Thanks! I can't listen to voice notes or open photos and stickers. Please tap an option below or type a short message.

messages.name: Message outside opening hours
messages.trigger: A message arrives when the salon is closed. Booking still works; a person replies later.
messages.body:
Hi! The salon is closed right now. We're open Tuesday to Friday 08:00–18:00 and Saturday 08:00–16:00.

I can book you in now, or someone will reply when we open.

messages.name: Reminder, the day before
messages.trigger: Sent at 18:00 the day before (setting). Outside the 24-hour window, so it’s a template with quick-reply buttons.

template.name: appointment_reminder
template.body:
Hi {{1}}, this is a reminder of your {{2}} appointment at Lerato's Braids & Beauty tomorrow, {{3}}, at {{4}}.

Can you still make it?
template.preview:
Hi Lindiwe, this is a reminder of your Knotless braids appointment at Lerato's Braids & Beauty tomorrow, Saturday 7 Nov, at 08:00.

Can you still make it?

messages.name: Reminder confirmed
messages.trigger: They tapped Confirm on C01. The booking shows “Confirmed” in the calendar.
messages.body: Thanks, Lindiwe. See you tomorrow at 08:00!

messages.name: Reminder for a clinic (neutral wording)
messages.trigger: Clinic variant. Names the practitioner, never the reason for the visit.

template.name: appointment_reminder_clinic
template.body: Hi {{1}}, a reminder of your appointment with {{2}} tomorrow, {{3}}, at {{4}}. Reply to confirm or change.
template.preview: Hi Thabo, a reminder of your appointment with Dr [name] tomorrow, Tuesday 10 Nov, at 14:30. Reply to confirm or change.

messages.note: No diagnosis, treatment or service name, ever. The admin shows clinic services as “Appointment” in all client messages.

messages.name: Booking made by the salon
messages.trigger: The owner adds or moves a booking by hand and the client’s 24-hour window is closed.

template.name: booking_confirmed_by_salon
template.body: Hi {{1}}, Lerato's Braids & Beauty has booked your {{2}} for {{3}} at {{4}}. Reply here if you need to change it.
template.preview: Hi Ayanda, Lerato's Braids & Beauty has booked your Silk press for Friday 6 Nov at 14:00. Reply here if you need to change it.

messages.name: Rejected template (example)
messages.trigger: What the Messages screen shows when WhatsApp rejects a template. This draft started with a variable, which isn’t allowed.

template.name: booking_moved_v1
template.body: {{1}}, your booking has moved to {{2}} at {{3}}.
template.preview: Lindiwe, your booking has moved to Tuesday 10 Nov at 10:30.

messages.note: Fixed in booking_moved_v2: “Hi {{1}}, your booking at Lerato’s Braids & Beauty has moved to {{2}} at {{3}}.” (pending)

messages.name: Pick a new day
messages.trigger: They tapped “Change time”, or wrote “can I change my booking”.
messages.body: No problem. Which day would you like instead?
messages.footer: Reply PERSON to talk to us

messages.name: Pick a new time
messages.trigger: A day is chosen.
messages.body: These times are open on *Tuesday 10 November*:
messages.footer: Reply PERSON to talk to us

rows.title: Another day
rows.description: Back to the list of days

messages.name: Confirm the change
messages.trigger: Shows old and new side by side. The old time is only released after they confirm.
messages.body:
Please confirm the change:

Was: Sat 7 Nov, 08:00
Now: *Tue 10 Nov, 10:30 to 14:30*

Knotless braids with Lerato

messages.name: Changed
messages.trigger: They confirmed. The calendar moves the block and marks it “Moved by client”.
messages.body:
Done! You're now booked for *Tuesday 10 November, 10:30 to 14:30*.

Knotless braids with Lerato. We'll remind you the day before.

messages.name: Confirm the cancellation
messages.trigger: They tapped Cancel, or wrote that they can’t make it.
messages.body: Cancel your *Knotless braids* on Saturday 7 Nov at 08:00?

messages.name: Cancelled
messages.trigger: They confirmed. The time is freed and offered to others.
messages.body: Your booking for Saturday 7 Nov at 08:00 is cancelled. Message us any time to book again.

messages.name: Cancelling inside the late window
messages.trigger: Less than 24 hours before the start. States the fee once, plainly, and still offers to move instead.
messages.body:
Your appointment is in less than 24 hours. Our policy has a late-cancellation fee of R [amount] for this.

Do you still want to cancel?
messages.footer: Reply PERSON to talk to us
messages.note: We never take payment in the chat. The fee is noted on the client profile for the owner to handle.

messages.name: Client asks for a person
messages.trigger: They tap “Ask a person”, type PERSON, or ask for someone. The bot pauses and the inbox flags the chat.
messages.body:
Sure. I've asked the team to reply here. During opening hours someone usually answers within [time].

You can keep typing in the meantime.
clientSaidBefore: can I speak to someone please

messages.name: A person takes over
messages.trigger: The owner taps “Take over” in the inbox. One line from the bot, then the owner writes as themselves.
messages.body: You're now chatting with *Lerato* from the salon.

staffAfter.text: Hi Lindiwe, Lerato here. Yes, I can do a shorter style on Saturday. It takes about 3 hours.

messages.name: Handed back to the assistant
messages.trigger: The owner taps “Hand back”. The bot picks up with a menu.
messages.body: Lerato has handed you back to the booking assistant. Anything else I can help with?

messages.name: Client replies STOP
messages.trigger: Any message that is just STOP (also STOPP, UNSUBSCRIBE). Stored on the profile with the date.
messages.body:
Done. We won't send you any more reminders or messages. Your booking on Saturday 7 Nov at 08:00 is still in place.

To get messages again, reply START.
messages.note: After STOP we never send templates. If they message us first, the assistant still answers inside the 24-hour window.

messages.name: Client replies START
messages.trigger: They opt back in.
messages.body: Welcome back. We'll send your confirmations and reminders here again.
